; B08_DispatchSoundCommand
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $8000. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Entry veneer for the command selected by SoundCommand. The bank is selected by the fixed-bank
; sound wrapper.
; B08_TickSoundChannels
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $8003. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Entry veneer for the channel update called once per scheduled sound tick.
; B08_SelectSoundHandler
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $8006. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Double the command in eight bits and reject doubled values >=72, giving36 reachable word slots.
; Push the selected high/low return word and RTS to word+1. The full finite dispatch domain is
; classified; this does not imply every command was naturally selected.
; B08_ResetSoundState
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $8017. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Clear channel state $CA..$F0 and APU registers $4000..$4013, then enable the four non-DMC
; channels. X is consumed.
; Disable all APU channels through $4015 and return. This six-byte tail duplicates the fixed-bank
; sound-disable sibling; natural selection remains unresolved.
; Sixteen duration bytes indexed by the packed note duration nibble. Values are audio tick counts;
; no instruction decoding is implied.
; B08_UpdateSoundVoices
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $804B. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Visit pulse records at $CA/$D4 and triangle/noise records at $DE/$E7. Zero disables a record;
; $FF chooses the direct stream path. X is the zero-page record base, Y the APU register offset.
; B08_SoundVoiceDisabled
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $805A. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Skip the inactive pulse voice and resume the shared voice iterator. The record base and hardware
; channel offset are carried from the caller.
; B08_SoundVoiceDisabledAlternate
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $806F. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Skip the inactive triangle/noise voice through the common iterator continuation.
; B08_AdvanceSoundPhrase
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $808C. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; End-of-note marker transfers to the phrase-command reader; this is a shared continuation rather
; than an independent calling contract.
; B08_ReloadDirectNoteTimer
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $808F. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Reload the per-channel duration before fetching the next direct note.
; B08_TickDirectNoteStream
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $8096. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Count down duration and repeat fields; fetch a timer-low byte and packed timer-high/duration
; byte through the note pointer. Triangle selector15 adds a four-tick cutoff. Completed iterator
; branches now skip inactive records through the shared channel loop.
; B08_ApplyTriangleCutoff
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $80DD. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Only triangle with selector 15 reaches the four-tick cutoff; write zero timer-low and high-
; control8.
; B08_ReloadEnvelopeNoteTimer
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $80FB. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Reload the envelope-path duration and continue at the next note record.
; B08_TickEnvelopeNoteStream
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $8102. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Decode timer/duration like the direct path, then use the channel control low nibble to select a
; nibble envelope. A nonzero envelope step advances its cursor; zero holds. Combine with the
; control high nibble for the channel control register.
; B08_ReadSoundPhraseCommand
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $8176. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Advance the phrase pointer and load a new note pointer, or interpret a zero-prefixed command.
; Command $FE reads a shared duration byte into both counters; $FF follows a little-endian phrase
; pointer without adding a return frame. Other channel-control paths share the same stream reader.
; B08_SavePulseControl
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $81AB. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Retain pulse control in the record; bit 4 controls whether the stored value is emitted directly.
; Other channels write the register without this pulse-specific state.
; B08_EnableDirectSoundVoice
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $81B6. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Store the direct-stream sentinel $FF in the voice control field after channel-specific control
; setup.
; B08_ReadSoundSweep
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $81BA. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Advance to the sweep/control byte and write the channel's second APU register, then resume
; phrase parsing.
; B08_SoundCommandFeFragment
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $81C5. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Advance the phrase pointer, then read the next byte into duration and remaining duration before
; continuing phrase parsing.
; B08_LoadPhraseDuration
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $81C8. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Read the next phrase byte into both duration and remaining-duration fields, then resume phrase
; parsing.
; B08_SoundCommandFfFragment
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $81D1. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Advance the phrase pointer and follow the little-endian replacement phrase pointer. The control-
; flow role is established; sound identity remains unresolved.
; B08_FollowPhrasePointer
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $81D4. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Read a little-endian replacement phrase pointer, preserving its low byte on the stack while
; fetching the high byte. Continue parsing at the new pointer without creating a return frame.
; B08_SilenceSoundVoice
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $81E4. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Clear channel volume/control, active state and duration counters. Returns to the channel
; updater.
; B08_AdvancePhrasePointer
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $81F0. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Increment the channel's 16-bit phrase pointer at record offsets1/2; preserve Y.
; B08_AdvanceNotePointer
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $81F7. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Increment the channel's 16-bit note pointer at record offsets3/4; preserve Y.
; B08_StartPulseOne
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $81FE. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Select zero-page record $CA and APU offset0 before the common inline-pointer initializer.
; B08_StartPulseTwo
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $8205. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Select zero-page record $D4 and APU offset 4 before the common inline-pointer initializer.
; B08_StartTriangle
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $820C. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Select zero-page record $DE and APU offset 8 before the common inline-pointer initializer.
; B08_StartNoiseVoice
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $8213. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Select the noise record at $E7 and hardware offset12; fall through to the shared initializer
; that consumes a two-byte inline pointer from its caller.
; B08_InitializeSoundVoice
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $8217. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Save X/Y across caller-inline pointer extraction. Reject a new command when an active voice has
; higher priority; otherwise install its phrase pointer and priority. A nonzero first byte starts
; a two-byte note; zero enters the named control parser, including silence and FE duration
; commands.
; B08_ParseInitialSoundControl
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $824C. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; A zero pointer-low byte introduces a command; zero silences and $FE updates duration. Other
; control bytes initialize APU control/sweep before returning to pointer parsing.
; B08_SetInitialSoundDuration
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $827F. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Read duration from the phrase stream into record offset 5, advance and resume parsing.
; Sixteen little-endian envelope pointers selected by the voice control low nibble, doubled for
; the word index. Payload holds amplitude steps, not return addresses.
; Bounded envelope amplitude bytes consumed as nibble steps by the voice updater; zero holds the
; cursor. Individual instrument identities and every original envelope subdivision remain
; unresolved.
; Thirty-six little-endian RTS return words. The command is doubled in eight bits and bounded
; below72; pushing a word then RTS enters word+1. Natural selection of every handler is not
; implied.
; B08_StartSoundTwoVoices
; Physical PRG bank 8, CPU entry $845D. Execution context follows the baseline views.
; Reset audio and initialize pulse2/triangle from two-byte caller-inline pointer operands. The
; initializer advances its caller return past each word; following sequence payload is data, not a
; normal instruction continuation.
; Two-byte little-endian caller-inline source pointer. The consuming helper reads it from the
; saved return and advances that return by two with carry; these bytes are not executed as the
; ordinary continuation.
; Classified continuation of B08_StartSoundTwoVoices.
; Intervening bytes are listed separately; this boundary alone is not a new routine entry.
; Two-byte little-endian caller-inline source pointer. The consuming helper reads it from the
; saved return and advances that return by two with carry; these bytes are not executed as the
; ordinary continuation.
; Classified continuation of B08_StartSoundTwoVoices.
; Intervening bytes are listed separately; this boundary alone is not a new routine entry.
; Bounded sound-stream data between independently established handlers. Repeated $00/$FE
; vocabulary agrees with the phrase reader. Exact cue/instrument identities and all stream
; subdivisions remain unresolved; the generic Data boundary does not assert one complete score.
